mods.name: MixedMeals
mods.description: This is a mod that takes vanilla food and potions and mixes them so you can have better food sources with potion effects and remain stackable

releases.notes:
# Changelog

All notable changes to **MixedMeals** are documented here.

## v0.1.0 — First release 🎉

The first public release of MixedMeals: cook vanilla food and potions together in a Wok to craft custom, stackable meals — and combine potion effects so their durations add up.

### ✨ Features

**The Wok**
- New **Wok** block with its own cooking-station screen (3×3 ingredient grid, two output slots and a progress arrow).
- Craftable from a **Cauldron + 2 Iron Chains + a Campfire** (Soul Campfire works too).
- Right-click to open; cooks automatically over ~10 seconds.

**Cooking & dishes**
- Turns food + potions into **5 dishes**: Sandwich, Stew, Salad, Fruit Salad and Garbage.
- Dish type is chosen from the ingredients' food categories (bread → Sandwich, meat → Stew, vegetables → Salad, fruit → Fruit Salad), using the standard Fabric common tags so modded foods work too.
- **Garbage** is produced for nonsensical mixes (conflicting potion effects, or potions with no real food).

**Combine potion effects ⏫ (the headline feature)**
- Cooking several potions of the **same** effect produces one meal whose effect **duration is the sum of all of them** — e.g. turn a handful of short Night Vision potions into a single long-lasting meal.
- Combining potions also blends their amplifiers, so meals can come out stronger as well as longer.
- Spent potions are refunded as **empty glass bottles** in the second output slot.

**Dish quality of life**
- Dishes carry **computed stats**: nutrition and saturation are summed from the ingredients, and the granted effect is applied on eat.
- Meals are **stackable** (unlike potions); identical meals stack together in the output.
- Effect-bearing meals show the **enchantment glint**.
- **Tooltip** lists the granted effect (in purple) and how much of each ingredient was used (e.g. `x2 Bread`, `x2 Steak`).
- The Wok's input slots only accept **food or potions**.

**Polish**
- Custom **item textures** for all five dishes, plus the Wok block model/texture.
- **English and Spanish** translations.

### 🛠️ Technical
- Built for **Minecraft 26.2** with **Fabric** (Loader 0.19.3+, Fabric API) and **Kotlin** (Fabric Language Kotlin).
- Framework-free **domain layer** for the cooking rules, covered by unit tests.
- **Data generation** for recipes and language files.
- Bilingual **README** and architecture decisions documented as ADRs under `docs/adr/`.
- CI: build-on-push workflow plus a **release workflow** that publishes the jars on every `v*` tag.

### 📦 Downloads
- `mixedmeals-0.1.0.jar` — the mod. Put this in your `mods/` folder.
- `mixedmeals-0.1.0-sources.jar` — source code, for developers (not needed to play).

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ · Fabric API · Fabric Language Kotlin
